title: Coefficient Target Scalar Span
statement: Let f:X -> T be separated [def-pc-morphism-conventions], F a quasi-coherent O_X-module [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], U an affine open of T, and Z an affine open of Y=f inverse image U. Let g:Tprime -> U, gprime:Xprime -> X, fprime:Xprime -> Tprime form a cartesian square [def-pc-fibre-product] with f and g followed by U. Let W=gprime inverse image of the image of Z in X and B an affine open of Tprime. Put A=Gamma(U,O), R=Gamma(B,O), N=Gamma(Z,F|Y) with the A-action of [def-pc-finite-affine-cech-model], and M=gprime^*F [def-pc-module-pullback]. Put I=W intersect fprime inverse image B, C=Gamma(I,O), and u(s)=the restriction to I of coefficientPullbackGenerator F Y Z gprime W hW s. Set k(s)=coefficientSupportIso.inv(u(s)) [lem-pc-finite-affine-cech-coefficient-comparison-map]. For every a in C and s in N, coefficientSupportIso.inv(a*u(s)) lies in span_R(range k).

proof.text: Apply coefficientIntersection_scalar_decomposition to express the intersection scalar as a finite sum of products rho(r_j)*delta(d_j), where rho is the restricted fprime section map and delta is the restricted gprime section map from V=the image of Z in X. This supplies precisely the affine ring calculation, including the empty case.

Let e=F.restrictAppIso and u be the restricted pullback generator. Define t_j=e.inv(d_j*e.hom(s)), a genuine section, not a chosen existence witness. Hom.app_smul for the pullback adjunction unit and two applications of Modules.map_smul give u(t_j)=delta(d_j)*u(s); the two structural restriction maps compose to the single map defining delta. coefficientSupportIso_smul and injectivity of its hom give inv(rho(r)*x)=r*inv(x).

Rewrite a by its finite product expansion. Distribute its action across the sum and map the sum through the additive inverse support map. For each product use mul_smul and the two proved transport formulas to obtain r_j*k(t_j). Each k(t_j) is a generator of the R-span, each R-multiple belongs to the span, and their finite sum belongs to it by Submodule.sum_mem. Restriction of scalars leaves the section carrier unchanged, so these are exactly the target generators.

lean.statement:
theorem coefficientTarget_scalar_span
    {X T : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ T) [IsSeparated f]
    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent]
    (U : T.Opens) (hU : IsAffineOpen U)
    (Z : (f ⁻¹ᵁ U).toScheme.Opens) (hZ : IsAffineOpen Z)
    {T' X' : Scheme.{u}} (g : T' ⟶ U.toScheme) (g' : X' ⟶ X) (f' : X' ⟶ T')
    (sq : IsPullback g' f' f (g ≫ U.ι))
    (W : X'.Opens) (hW : W = g' ⁻¹ᵁ ((f ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι ''ᵁ Z))
    (B : T'.Opens) (hB : IsAffineOpen B) :
    letI : Algebra Γ(U.toScheme, ⊤) Γ(T', B) :=
      (g.appLE ⊤ B (by simp)).hom.toAlgebra
    let N := (ModuleCat.restrictScalars
      (((Scheme.ΓSpecIso Γ(U.toScheme, ⊤)).inv ≫
        ((f ∣_ U) ≫ U.toScheme.toSpecΓ).appTop).hom)).obj
          ((F.restrict (f ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι).presheafModuleCat.obj (op Z))
    let M := (pullback g').obj F
    ∀ (a : Γ(X', W ⊓ f' ⁻¹ᵁ B)) (s : N),
      (coefficientSupportIso f' M W B).inv
        (a • (M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left : W ⊓ f' ⁻¹ᵁ B ≤ W)).op
            (coefficientPullbackGenerator F (f ⁻¹ᵁ U) Z g' W hW s))) ∈
      Submodule.span (Γ(T', B)) (Set.range (fun t : N ↦
        (coefficientSupportIso f' M W B).inv
          (M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left : W ⊓ f' ⁻¹ᵁ B ≤ W)).op
            (coefficientPullbackGenerator F (f ⁻¹ᵁ U) Z g' W hW t))))
